test: comparable = the deepest of four lexicographic rungs the candidate reaches: (1) same SECTOR (scanner UniverseDataRow.sector; a model-block subject's GICS_SECTOR_NAME is mapped into that vocabulary by GICS11_TO_SCANNER13_v1), then (2) a SIZE BAND of 0.2x-5.0x of the subject's market cap (UniverseDataRow.mktVal in USD millions; a model-block subject's CUR_MKT_CAP divided by 1e6), then (3) same COUNTRY (UniverseDataRow.country; CNTRY_OF_DOMICILE mapped by ISO3166A2_TO_SCANNER_COUNTRY_v1), then (4) same SUBSECTOR (UniverseDataRow.industryGroup); ties inside the deepest rung broken by the numeric similarity |log(candidate cap / subject cap)|. Similarity of business and scale, never valuation.
